ar.title: حساء التربية بالبيض والكريمة

steps.n1: يُضرب صفار البيض ويُضاف إلى الكريمة.
steps.n2: يُرفع المرق على النار حتى يقترب من الغليان.
steps.n3: يُرفع المرق بعيداً عن النار ويُضاف إليه خليط الصفار والكريمة مع التقليب الجيد.
steps.n4: يُعاد الإناء على نار هادئة جداً أو بجانب النار مع استمرار التقليب حتى يثخن الحساء، بشرط ألا يغلي وإلا انفصلت أجزاؤه.
steps.n5: يُتبل بالملح والفلفل ويُقدم معه الخبز المحمر أو المحمص.

en.title: Soup Thickened with Egg and Cream

steps.n1: Beat the egg yolks and add them to the cream.
steps.n2: Heat the stock until it is almost boiling.
steps.n3: Take the stock off the heat and add the yolk and cream mixture, stirring well.
steps.n4: Return the pot to very low heat, or set it beside the heat, and keep stirring until the soup thickens, making sure it does not boil or it will separate.
steps.n5: Season with salt and pepper and serve with the fried or toasted bread.

legacySteps: Beat the egg yolks and add them to the cream.
Heat the stock until it is almost boiling.
Take the stock off the heat and add the yolk and cream mixture, stirring well.
Return the pot to very low heat, or set it beside the heat, and keep stirring until the soup thickens, making sure it does not boil or it will separate.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with the fried or toasted bread.
